summary: Learn carbon footprint measurement and reporting with practical tools, Scope 1-3 methods, and report templates. Enrol to build defensible carbon inventories.
lede: Carbon footprint measurement and reporting helps sustainability, ESG, and operations professionals quantify emissions and prepare documented reports. The course covers setting organizational boundaries, tracing activity data, and applying emission factors to calculate Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 emissions, alongside assessing Scope 3 data quality and organizing results for internal review or external reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already touch emissions, operations, ESG, or reporting work and need a more structured carbon accounting method. It suits people who must gather data, calculate emissions, and prepare credible reporting outputs for internal or external stakeholders. If you work with sustainability disclosures, operational data, or supplier reporting, this course gives you a practical framework for carbon footprint measurement and reporting. Sustainability Managers responsible for carbon inventory preparation and disclosure input. ESG Analysts collecting activity data and emission factors for reporting. Environmental Compliance Officers reviewing carbon reporting evidence and audit trails. Operations Managers tracking energy, fuel, and process emissions. Carbon Accounting Specialists calculating scope-based emissions and intensities. Climate Reporting Officers drafting emissions narratives and target updates. Supply Chain Managers requesting supplier emissions data and Scope 3 inputs. Energy Managers validating utility and fuel consumption records. Corporate Responsibility Leads aligning carbon data with sustainability strategy. Finance Business Partners supporting emissions data controls and reporting sign-off.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop, a spreadsheet application such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, and basic familiarity with operational data such as energy, fuel, travel, or procurement records. No coding or programming is required. If available, bring a sample emissions dataset, utility bill, travel log, or supplier data extract for exercise work.
